datasets.title: Expanded Blorenge landscape context / Cyd-destun tirwedd ehangach Blorenge
datasets.provider: Blorenge Commoners Association, Natural Resources Wales, OpenStreetMap contributors and Geofabrik
datasets.licence: BCA publication authority, OGL 3.0 and ODbL 1.0 by source
datasets.attribution: Blorenge Commoners Association; contains NRW and Ordnance Survey information under the recorded attribution; © OpenStreetMap contributors; processed by Geofabrik.
datasets.method: Preserve the canonical BCA core, derive its exact 2 km AOI in EPSG:27700, and clip only allowlisted context fields to that AOI.
datasets.uncertainty: Source dates and completeness vary; the BCA core is approximate and contextual paths do not establish legal status.
limitations: The BCA-area is not the legal, official, surveyed or current CL18 boundary.
The SSSI remains an independent authoritative context layer.

datasets.title: Expanded Blorenge terrain context / Cyd-destun tir ehangach Blorenge
datasets.licence: Open Government Licence 3.0 and BCA publication authority
datasets.attribution: Welsh Government LiDAR; processed by Blorenge Commoners Association.
datasets.method: Mosaic the 163 exact intersecting 1 m DTM tiles, average to 10 m inside the expanded AOI, then derive fixed hillshade and contours.
datasets.uncertainty: Capture dates vary by tile and hillshade is a visualisation.
limitations: Not produced specifically for flood modelling.
Terrain does not describe current surface cover.

datasets.title: Observed surface and vegetation change / Newid arwyneb a llystyfiant a arsylwyd
datasets.provider: European Union Copernicus programme, USGS and BCA processing
datasets.licence: Copernicus Sentinel data legal notice, USGS public domain and BCA publication authority
datasets.attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2025–2026; Landsat imagery courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey; processing by Blorenge Commoners Association.
datasets.method: Apply the common Sentinel mask, require three-observation comparability, calculate continuous dNBR/NDVI/NDMI and publish the conservative uncalibrated combined states; Landsat corroboration remains separate and unfused.
datasets.uncertainty: Evidence states are not locally calibrated severity and do not establish pixel-level cause.
limitations: Not proof of ecological condition or recovery.
No exact incident-authority perimeter is available.
Not observed is never no change.

datasets.title: Vegetation greenness index change (NDVI) / Newid mynegai gwyrddni llystyfiant (NDVI)
datasets.provider: European Union Copernicus programme; BCA processing
datasets.licence: Copernicus Sentinel data legal notice and BCA publication authority
datasets.attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2025–2026; processing by Blorenge Commoners Association.
datasets.method: Publish NDVI(2026-08-11) minus NDVI(2025-07-12) from native B8/B4 at 10 m after the common SCL mask.
datasets.uncertainty: Rainfall, phenology, grazing, management and residual observation effects may contribute.
limitations: Does not establish cause, fire damage, severity, habitat condition or recovery.
Not observed pixels fail one or both date masks.

datasets.title: Moisture-sensitive index change (NDMI) / Newid mynegai sy’n sensitif i leithder (NDMI)
datasets.provider: European Union Copernicus programme; BCA processing
datasets.licence: Copernicus Sentinel data legal notice and BCA publication authority
datasets.attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2025–2026; processing by Blorenge Commoners Association.
datasets.method: Publish NDMI(2026-08-11) minus NDMI(2025-07-12) from native B8A/B11 at 20 m after the common SCL mask.
datasets.uncertainty: Rainfall, phenology, grazing, management and residual observation effects may contribute.
limitations: Does not establish cause, fire damage, severity, dryness or wetness.
Not observed pixels fail one or both date masks.

datasets.title: EFFIS provisional provider boundary / Ffin dros dro y darparwr EFFIS
datasets.provider: European Union, Copernicus EFFIS; BCA processing
datasets.licence: CC BY 4.0 and BCA publication authority
datasets.attribution: European Union, Copernicus EFFIS; clipped and reformatted by Blorenge Commoners Association.
datasets.method: Reacquire complete provider feature 592404, preserve its fields and snapshot, compare it with release one, and clip only the display geometry to the expanded AOI.
datasets.uncertainty: Provider dates and geometry are not incident-authority truth.
limitations: Not an authority, legal or surveyed perimeter.
Does not validate raster change or thermal anomalies.
